name: Cerebrium
insight: Cape Town-founded and YC-backed; raised an $8.5M seed led by Gradient in 2025 to scale its real-time serverless GPU platform.
tagline: Serverless GPU infrastructure for real-time AI — voice, video, and LLM workloads.
description: A serverless GPU platform for deploying real-time AI workloads — voice agents, video models, and LLMs — with cold starts in seconds, instant autoscaling, and multi-region failover. Bring custom code, Dockerfiles, or frameworks like vLLM and pay per second of compute across 12+ GPU types.
edge: Tuned for real-time voice and video agents: cold starts in seconds, 12+ GPU types, and multi-region failover under a per-second usage bill.
cons: Hobby tier capped at 3 apps, 5 GPUs

references.title: SA's Cerebrium raises $8.5m to scale serverless AI platform
